description: This file defines the implementation of the RoadLogEvent class, including a toString method for formatting log messages and a helper function for processing format strings. It is part of the Qhull library's exception handling system.

classes.name: RoadLogEvent
classes.description: Class representing log events and exceptions in Qhull, with methods for string conversion and format processing.

methods.name: RoadLogEvent::toString
methods.description: Converts a log event to a formatted string based on a tag and code, processing the format string for placeholders.

methods.name: RoadLogEvent::firstExtraCode
methods.description: Helper function to determine if a character is the first extra code in a format string, updating the extraCode accordingly.
